## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne.md) for putting wild flowers on her hat, but then brings her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) quickly hit it off in the garden, solemnly vowing to be best friends forever. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a package of chocolate sweets, bringing her immense joy.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> During a party at Diana's house, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) experiences a deep realization of how much she cares for the girl. Bedridden for seven weeks while her ankle heals, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to recommend that she join an advanced class preparing for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) is thrilled at the opportunity to study toward becoming a teacher and gladly accepts. After the class is organized, [Anne](../character/anne.md) navigates the dynamic of studying alongside her peers—including her rival, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)—while missing [Diana](../character/diana.md), who is not taking the exam.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) travel along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to collect subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to repaint the local hall. They encounter pessimistic Miss [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md), who refuses to give anything, though her sister Catherine secretly donates afterwards. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how they helped flustered Dan Blair mix a cake in exchange for a generous donation, followed by their visit to meticulous Mrs. Theodore White.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) to do household chores while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) goes to help Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While transferring bed feathers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly applies rug dye to her nose instead of freckle lotion, turning it bright red just before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) wash off the dye and supplies a roast chicken, allowing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to successfully entertain her visitors with a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) rest in the orchard at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), discussing the upcoming changes as [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares to leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but cuts their quiet moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before sitting alone by the brook.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they receive gifts before [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The next evening, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes her on a walk through the woods to find a wild apple tree, restoring her spirits ahead of her departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn
